rubric: After reviewed records a completed plan review, editing that plan still leaves suggest --plan reporting it as done for this file content.
trigger: Run reviewed docs/plans/cache.md --how fresh-context, edit that plan, then run suggest --plan docs/plans/cache.md in JSON or text form.
user_impact: The review status no longer matches the saved plan. Substantial new design changes can skip the required review before implementation.
intended_lookalikes: A saved --plan triggers deep mode even without Git.
The default auto switch selects a fresh-context review rather than full EGM.
A done review counts again when the file returns to exactly its reviewed bytes; a cut review never counts.
